ui_bugs.issue: Mobile Contact menu item gets data-testid='mobile-mobile-nav-access-link' instead of the expected 'mobile-nav-access-link'. Root cause at Nav.jsx line ~160: `l.id.replace("nav-", "mobile-nav-")` is applied to the Contact entry whose id is already 'mobile-nav-access-link'. String.replace() replaces the first occurrence of 'nav-' inside that string (at index 7), producing 'mobile-mobile-nav-access-link'. Fix: special-case the contact entry to keep its id as-is (e.g., `l.id.startsWith('mobile-') ? l.id : l.id.replace('nav-', 'mobile-nav-')`).

action_items: Fix Nav.jsx mobile Contact link testid (see ui_bugs[0]); trivial one-line change so playwright regressions can find mobile-nav-access-link.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx uses `.replace('nav-','mobile-nav-')` on l.id which double-prefixes when l.id already starts with 'mobile-nav-' (Contact entry). Minor but bites automated tests.

When testing theme toggle, note that dark mode is applied but NOT via `document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')` — check computed background/screenshot instead.
rca of the issue: Nav.jsx spreads `[...links, { to: '/contact', label: 'Contact', id: 'mobile-nav-access-link' }]` then does `l.id.replace('nav-', 'mobile-nav-')` uniformly. The Contact entry's id already begins with 'mobile-nav-' so the first substring 'nav-' (inside 'mobile-nav-access-link' at position 7) gets replaced, yielding 'mobile-mobile-nav-access-link'. Repro: viewport 390x844 → open Home → scroll → click [data-testid='nav-menu-toggle'] → inspect Contact link. Mitigation: guard the replace, e.g. `const tid = l.id.startsWith('mobile-') ? l.id : l.id.replace('nav-','mobile-nav-');`
